name: Activity Template Performance
description: Analyze activity template success rates, costs, and execution times

prompt.template: Query the activity API endpoint /v2/activities/templates to get all templates with their performance metrics. Display as a bar chart showing success rate by template. Include: Template Name, Success Rate (%), Total Executions.
Query execution traces to calculate average cost per template. Display as a table with columns: Template Name, Total Executions, Total Cost (USD), Avg Cost per Execution, Cost per Success.
Query execution traces to get execution duration statistics per template. Create a box plot or table showing: Template Name, Min Duration, Max Duration, Median Duration, P95 Duration.
For template {{templateId}}, query all variants and compare their Thompson Sampling scores, success rates, and execution counts. Display as a comparison table or grouped bar chart.

variables.name: templateId
variables.description: Base template ID to compare variants

prompt.template: Query recent recommendation events to see which templates are being selected by Thompson Sampling. Show distribution over time as a stacked area chart or heatmap.
